content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an issue with the invalidation of the Page Directory (PD) after writing to the PP_DCLV register when switching memory management contexts. This led to improper handling of the page table entries, resulting in the need to preallocate ppGTT entries during initialization and reload the memory management context multiple times to work around a timing issue. The original downgrade to aliasing-ppgtt was due to these problems, which were resolved by re-enabling full-ppgtt for the affected Intel architectures (Ivy Bridge and Haswell).
